answer_1.quote: Data-to-Text aims at generating natural language descriptions from structured data
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions from structured data

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU scores as well as PARENT (precision, recall and F1) scores

answer_4.quote: We perform qualitative evaluation following the best practices outlined by (van der ...). Our human annotators are males and females from several countries across Europe, between 20 and 55 years old and proficient in English.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked, for each sentence, to score its fluency (as Fluent, Mostly fluent, or Not fluent) factualness (likewise), and coverage (in terms of the number of realized rows).
